noticias.titulo: Nvidia leads tech sell-off as Huang comeback rally fizzles and AI concerns return - CNBC
noticias.resumo:
In this article

Technology stocks plunged on Wednesday as excitement over Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return faded and failed to calm mounting concerns over the sustainability of the artificial intelligence trade. 

The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite dropped nearly 4%.  Semiconductor stocks dragged on the index, and the VanEck Semiconductor ETF that tracks the sector plummeted 7%.

noticias.titulo: Nvidia Shares Fall 5% in Premarket Trading as Goldman Sachs Highlights Lingering Uncertainty Following Huang’s Return
noticias.resumo:
Nvidia's announcement on Monday contributed to Wall Street's strongest daily performance since April 2025, with renewed investor interest in artificial intelligence-related stocks extending into Asian markets on Tuesday. 

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), a major Nvidia supplier, gained more than 9% in Taiwan, while Japanese semiconductor testing equipment manufacturer Advantest advanced more than 12%. 

South Korean memory chip manufacturers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, which also supply Nvidia, each recorded gains exceeding 6%.
